DOOR EQUIPPED WITH ELECTRIFIED PANIC DEVICE CONNECTED TO THE BUILDING ACCESS CONTROL SYSTEM.
DOOR IS MONITORED AND MAY BE CONTROLLED REMOTELY BY THE SECURITY SYSTEM. PANIC DEVICE PROVIDES
DOOR EQUIPPED WITH ELECTRIFIED CYLINDRICAL LOCKSET CONNECTED TO THE ACCESS CONTROL SYSTEM. LOCK
OPERATION IS CONTROLLED BY SECURITY SYSTEM (BADGE READER OR REMOTE RELEASE). DOOR POSITION IS
DOOR EQUIPPED WITH PANIC DEVICE BUT NOT CONTROLLED BY THE ACCESS CONTROL SYSTEM. DOOR INCLUDES
A DOOR POSITION SWITCH FOR MONITORING ONLY. PANIC HARDWARE PROVIDES IMMEDIATE EGRESS.
DOOR EQUIPPED WITH MECHANICAL CYLINDRICAL STOREROOM OR CLASSROOM LOCKSET. DOOR IS NOT ACCESS
CONTROLLED BUT INCLUDES A DOOR POSITION SWITCH CONNECTED TO THE SECURITY MONITORING SYSTEM.
